# Look recipes: Action and combat

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_references.py from scripts/catalog.py. Edit the catalogue, then rebuild. -->

Read this file when the user names a martial-arts film, a duel, a war film or an action cartoon.
A recipe is that look as decisions, in words that name no film and no person. The id is the neutral name.

## Frozen-time action

`id: frozen-time-action`

**What makes that look:**

- Time almost stops at the peak of the action. The camera keeps moving around the person.
- The colour is cold, with a little green in it.
- The move happens 1 time. Before it and after it, the speed is real.

- **Shot:** Frozen-moment arc (bullet time) (`frozen_arc`).
- **Light:** One hard low sun, camera facing into the light.
- **Grade:** Cool and desaturated.
- **Prompt words:** time almost stops at the peak of the action while the camera sweeps part of the way around, cold colour with a slight green cast, dark plain clothes.
- **Other shots of this look:** Speed ramp; Low-angle wide shot; Long-lens profile close-up.

## Martial-arts full-body action

`id: martial-arts-wide`

**What makes that look:**

- The whole body is in the frame, from head to feet. The viewer sees the skill.
- The shots are long. A cut does not hide the action.
- After a contact, the lens snaps to a face.

- **Shot:** Crash zoom (snap zoom) (`crash_zoom`).
- **Light:** Flat overcast daylight.
- **Grade:** Muted earth tones.
- **Prompt words:** whole bodies visible from head to feet, long shots without a cut so the skill is visible, a fast snap zoom to a face after a contact.
- **Other shots of this look:** Contact insert with a ramp on contact; Tracking shot (lateral dolly); Low-angle wide shot.

## Samurai duel

`id: samurai-duel`

**What makes that look:**

- Two people stand in profile, far apart, in a wide frame.
- Wind, rain or dust moves. The people do not.
- After a long stillness there is 1 fast move. Then stillness again.

- **Shot:** Locked-off wide (tableau) (`locked_wide`).
- **Light:** Flat overcast daylight.
- **Grade:** Black and white.
- **Prompt words:** two figures in profile far apart in a wide frame, wind in the grass or rain between them, a long stillness, then one fast move.
- **Other shots of this look:** Long-lens profile close-up; Contact insert with a ramp on contact; Tracking shot (lateral dolly).

## Staccato war combat

`id: staccato-combat`

**What makes that look:**

- The camera is at the height of the ground, with the people.
- Motion is sharp and jerky, with no soft blur.
- The colour is washed out. The sky is grey. Dirt hits the lens.

- **Shot:** Handheld close coverage (`handheld_close`).
- **Light:** Flat overcast daylight.
- **Grade:** Bleach bypass.
- **Prompt words:** a camera on the shoulder at the height of the ground, sharp jerky motion with no blur, washed-out colour, dirt on the lens, grey daylight.
- **Other shots of this look:** Follow shot (from behind); Low-angle wide shot; Fast-cut showcase (montage).

## Animated action framing

`id: animated-action`

**What makes that look:**

- The frame uses strong diagonal lines. Nothing is level.
- There is a held, still pose before the contact. Then one very fast move.
- The background turns into streaks of speed. The contact is one sharp frame.

- **Shot:** Contact insert with a ramp on contact (`impact_insert`).
- **Light:** Low hard side sun.
- **Grade:** Film print, deep blacks.
- **Prompt words:** strong diagonal lines, a held pose before the contact, streaks of speed behind the figure, the contact as one sharp frame.
- **Other shots of this look:** Low-angle wide shot; Whip pan (swish pan); Speed ramp.
